description: Welcome to the 25THREE Community Dance Fundraiser! Get ready for a dynamic and energetic show, featuring local adult training group 25THREE and various guest performers. Directed by Kristen Grace, our group features dancers 20-50 years of age with diverse backgrounds in movement and performance. Some are hitting the stage for the first time in their lives and others are returning after a 10 year hiatus. We believe that intentional and holistic dance training should be available to everyone, regardless of age or ability. Funds raised from this performance will be used for start up costs to open our very own space! We are thrilled to bring this show to our community and hope you will consider supporting our vision. Hosted by Isaiah Rashaad, you can expect laughs and great energy – paired with high energy dance performances, a bar, photo booth, raffles AND door prizes. For more information on our group and the vision for our new space please visit 25threedance.com and follow us on Instagram at @25_three. This is an all ages show, but please note some acts may have unedited music or more suggestive movement. Parents should use discretion with children attending.

title: 30th Annual Model Train Festival
description: 30th Annual Model Train Festival Friday, December 18, 2026 to Friday, January 1, 2027 Closed December 24 & 25 Open Mondays during Model Train Festival Included with Admission. Kids 5 and under are free! Celebrate with us as Model Train Festival returns for its 30th year at the Washington State History Museum! Join us for a beloved Tacoma holiday tradition that brings history and imagination to life for all ages. Explore intricate model train layouts, enjoy hands-on family activities, watch train films in the auditorium, and capture memories at festive photo stations. Whether you re a lifelong rail fan or simply looking for holiday fun, the Model Train Festival promises magical moments and memories for all! As a special thank you to members for their continued support, a 20% double discount in the Museum Store will be valid for the entirety of Model Train Festival. Puget Sound Model Railroad Engineers – Washington s largest permanent model train layout, depicting Tacoma in the 1950s. Explore four floors of room-sized layouts from local model railroad clubs, each with its own unique theme, such as Tacoma in the 1950s, European villages, and scenes from across Washington State. Don t miss your chance to see a rotating selection of limited-run displays, including the Tribute to Seattle layout, a 1930s Sonoran Desert landscape, and a Z-scale club featuring model trains at an astonishing 1:220 scale, the smallest on the market! Special Events Model Train Festival Member Night Saturday, December 19, 2026, 5:30 – 8:00 PM Members, get ready for an exclusive night at the 30th Annual Model Train Festival at the Washington State History Museum! This special, members-only evening invites you to experience the magic of model railroading without the crowds. Enjoy private access to our spectacular model train layouts and much more at Member Night! Model Railroading Workshops December 21, 22 – 10:00 AM Included with admission for the first 20 participants. With the National Model Railroad Association Discover the world of model railroading in an interactive workshop led by experts from the National Model Railroad Association. Included with museum admission, this engaging session is perfect for kids ages 8–12, but everyone is encouraged to join. Workshop supplies are limited to the first 20 participants each day ,so arrive early on December 21 and 22, starting at 10:00 AM.

This high-energy production features back by popular demand, The Shades of Blue , the iconic group behind the 1966 #1 hit Oh How Happy! and inductees into the Rhythm & Blues Hall of Fame. The all-star cast includes celebrated Motown performers such as Stuart Avig , original lead singer of one Motown s First Recording Groups, The Valadiers; Charles Davis , former lead of The Contours; Delbert Nelson , former lead singer of The Funk Brothers ; and acclaimed drummer Baby Ray Moore who has played behind Aretha Franklin and Stevie Wonder . big_desc: From the producers of the hit 60s Flashback Show comes A Very Merry Christmas Show — a spectacular, all-new holiday celebration filled with music, memories and Christmas magic! Featuring more than 20 of the Northwest s favorite vocalists and an incredible cast of dancers, A Very Merry Christmas Show takes audiences on an unforgettable journey through Christmas past to present — from the beloved songs and traditions of the 1940s and 50s, through the unforgettable Christmas television specials of the 60s and 70s, and all the way to the holiday favorites we love today. Expect soaring vocals, show-stopping dance numbers, dazzling costumes, heartwarming nostalgia and treasured memories of Christmases gone by — all brought to life in the same high-energy, nostalgic style audiences loved in 60s Flashback. After sold-out performances in Seattle, this much-loved holiday production is coming south for one special night at the Federal Way Performing Arts & Events Center. And the magic doesn t end when the curtain comes down! Santa Claus will be waiting in the lobby after the show to meet the kids, making this a Christmas memory the whole family can share. This year, A Very Merry Christmas Show is also proud to partner with local charity PB&J for the Homeless. Guests are invited to join in the spirit of giving by bringing a jar of peanut butter or jelly to donate in the lobby on the night of the performance. Kick-start your Christmas spirit with an unforgettable night of music, dancing, laughter, nostalgia and holiday magic for the whole family. And be ready for a magical finale you won t soon forget.

title: Auburn Symphony Orchestra: Rhythm & Revelry
description: NULL
big_desc: A season finale is a celebration. Rhythm & Revelry begins with sacred joy in Omar Thomas Come Sunday, a tribute to the Hammond organ s central place in Black worship. The first movement, Testimony, prepares the spirit with a sound world shaped by Bach, blues, jazz, and R&B. The second, Shout!, bursts into the ecstatic moment when celebration takes over. Thomas writes with love, energy, and purpose, honoring Black culture through music that sings, moves, and lifts the room. From there, the spotlight turns to violinist Nathan Amaral in Tchaikovsky s Violin Concerto. Born in Rio de Janeiro, Amaral began violin through a social project in Mangueira and has since become one of the most compelling young violinists on the international stage. He won First Prize at the 2024 Sphinx Competition and the Grand Prize of the 2024 CAG-YCAT Competitions, and Yo-Yo Ma has praised his rare ability to move beyond technique into the heart of musical expression. Tchaikovsky s concerto gives him a perfect canvas: soaring melodies, dazzling passagework, and emotional sweep from first note to last. Then Auburn Symphony takes center stage. Ravel s Boléro begins with a single rhythm and one unforgettable theme, repeating again and again as the music grows from a whisper to a blaze. Each section of the orchestra gets its moment to shine, turning one simple idea into a thrilling display of color and control. Strauss Der Rosenkavalier Suite brings the afternoon to a lavish close. Drawn from his beloved opera, the suite mixes romantic sweep with elegant waltzes and the glittering richness of Vienna imagined through Strauss 20th-century orchestral voice. From worship to virtuosity to full-orchestra spectacle, Rhythm & Revelry sends the season out with brilliance, abundance, and joy.

title: Auburn Symphony Orchestra: Symphonic Stories
description: NULL
big_desc: Some forces are invisible, but you feel their pull. Symphonic Stories brings together three works about distance, memory, imagination, and the stories that hold us together. A voice reaches across grief. A soloist moves through shifting celestial worlds. A woman tells story after story, surviving one night at a time. Jennifer Higdon s blue cathedral begins the journey in a place of remembrance. Written after the death of her brother, Andrew Blue Higdon, the piece imagines a vast sacred space filled with light, crystal, and upward motion. The flute, Higdon s instrument, and the clarinet, her brother s instrument, move through the music like two voices reaching toward one another. It is a work of loss, but also of release: a quiet ascent through memory toward something larger. From there, Auburn Symphony looks outward with the Co-Commission of Gravity at a Distance, a new saxophone concerto by Viet Cuong written for Timothy McAllister. The concerto takes inspiration from celestial bodies and the unseen forces that bind them across immense distances. The solo saxophone moves through orchestral worlds that feel luminous, floating, dense, and immense, tracing a path between isolation and attraction, stillness and motion. Then comes one of music s great storytellers. Rimsky-Korsakov s Scheherazade draws from One Thousand and One Nights, where Scheherazade survives a violent ruler not through force, but through intelligence, wit, and imagination. Each night, she tells a story compelling enough to earn another dawn. In the orchestra, her voice returns through the solo violin: persuasive, resilient, and unbroken. With blue cathedral, Gravity at a Distance, and Scheherazade, Symphonic Stories becomes a concert about what connects us across silence, space, and danger. These are stories of remembrance, invention, and survival, told in the language of the orchestra.

title: Auburn Symphony Orchestra: The Music of Studio Ghibli
description: NULL
big_desc: This concert will not have Joe Hisaishi in attendance nor show any of the films. A girl takes flight on a broomstick. A forest spirit waits beneath the trees. A young girl wanders into a bathhouse for gods. A castle lumbers across the hills on impossible legs. For generations of fans, Studio Ghibli has created animated films that feel both fantastical and deeply human. Founded in Japan and closely associated with filmmaker Hayao Miyazaki, the studio has become one of the most beloved names in animation, with stories known for wonder, adventure, environmental beauty, and characters who find courage in unfamiliar worlds. At the heart of many of those films is the music of Joe Hisaishi. His scores do more than accompany the action. They give these worlds their breath, motion, and emotional pull. Like John Williams long partnership with Steven Spielberg, Hisaishi s music has helped shape the identity of the films themselves. Led by Music Director Wesley Schulz, Auburn Symphony celebrates the music of Kiki s Delivery Service, My Neighbor Totoro, Spirited Away, and Howl s Moving Castle in a concert filled with soaring melodies, playful characters, sweeping orchestral color, and moments of quiet beauty. Fans will recognize the themes they love. New listeners will hear why this music has reached far beyond the screen. The Music of Studio Ghibli is a concert for families, anime fans, film lovers, and anyone ready for an evening of adventure, nostalgia, and imagination.

As the days grow shorter, heading outdoors can feel harder. Take a break from life s pressures and join us for this late fall walk at the beautiful Wapato Park. We will listen to the trees, pay attention to the many native plants around us, breathe in together and reflect by the lake.

Make sure to check the forecast. Bring layers, comfortable shoes, water, and anything else you need to be comfortable. We hold our walks rain or shine. If in doubt, please check our social media and website calendar for updates.

Cuando los días se hacen más cortos, se nos antoja menos salir de casa. Pero reunirnos con otra gente en el día, entre los árboles y cerca del agua, puede revitalizarnos en la temporada de frío y ayudarnos a vivir el invierno con más intención. Te invitamos a descansar de las presiones del día a día en esta caminata otoñal en el hermoso Wapato Park. Pondremos atención a lo que nos dicen los árboles y las plantas autóctonas que nos rodean. Respiraremos hondo y reflexionaremos juntes a la orilla del lago.

Consulta el clima antes de salir de casa. Te recomendamos usar capas, zapatos cómodos, y traer cualquier otra cosa que sea necesaria para que estés cómode durante nuestro tiempo juntos. Sólo cancelamos nuestras caminatas si el clima supone un riesgo para los asistentes. Si tienes dudas, consulta nuestro sitio web y medios sociales para confirmar el estatus del evento.

Whether you re brand new or looking to strengthen your technique, this class offers a welcoming space to build confidence, improve rhythm, and enjoy the music. We ll cover basics, turns, lead-and-follow skills, and style, even how to add your own personality to the dance. No partner required; we ll rotate throughout the class. Wear comfortable clothing. Women are encouraged to wear heels, men dress shoes, but not required. Gym shoes are ok. Join us for a fun, social, and empowering experience that brings people together through music, movement, and community.

Celebrate life, memory, and culture at our free, family-friendly Día de los Muertos event! Join us for a day of vibrant traditions, creative activities, and opportunities to come together as a community. This is a joyful and welcoming celebration for all ages.

Reserve your free timed entry

Admission is free, but registration is required. Choose an arrival time when you register; once you re here, stay as long as you like.

Reserve Your Free Time Slot Here!

What to expect

  • Community ofrendas (altars) created by local artists and community members
  • A traditional tapete (sand painting)
  • Live music and dance performances
  • Hands-on art-making for all ages
  • Food and local artisan vendors

Full 2026 event schedule coming soon. Check back here for performance times, activities, and vendors.

Tacoma Art Museum is located at 1701 Pacific Avenue, Tacoma, WA 98402.

Costume policy

  • Masquerade-style masks covering only the eyes and upper half of the face are welcome.
  • Face paint may cover no more than half of the face.

A celebration for everyone: This is a celebration of life and community. Harassment or hateful speech will not be tolerated.

title: Federale
description: Founded in 2004, Federale has released seven cinematic records inspired by obscure spaghetti westerns, folk-based murder ballads, 60s and 70s European soundtracks, and stylishly dramatic vocalists such as Lee Hazelwood and Nick Cave. Federales music has appeared in films, including A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night, The Bad Batch, and The Lego Movie, while the band has toured extensively throughout North America and Europe. Federales newest album Love & Other Lies (2026) teems with a dark sentimentality and a pronounced gloomy sensibility drawing from British new wave, post-punk, goth, and 1960s rock n roll. Strains of The Cure, Depeche Mode, The Sisters of Mercy, Siouxsie and the Banshees, Tears for Fears, and even The Beatles abound. Here, lead singer and primary songwriter Collin Hegnas emotive baritone is swathed in period-perfect Prophet-5 synthesizers and glistening counter-melody guitar lines, and supported by intricate but lyrical basslines and coldly mechanical drums. Love & Other Lies picks up where Federales previous album, Reverb & Seduction, left off. That album was a radical departure from the bands previous releases which featured mostly instrumentals. There are a lot more similarities than you think, Hegna says of the groups seemingly two distinct aesthetic periods. When we were referencing the obscure influences, we liked the drama and darkness. Those elements are in new wave, goth, and post-punk. I just grabbed another couple of colors from the Crayon box. Website: http://federalepdx.com/ About Cockaphonix Cockaphonix Holiday Dan (drums) and Rayko Stanislav (piano) started a cacophony of curious clanging helter skelter sounds in 2017. Using a 100 year old upright Meister piano which has travelled across the west and a rickety Pearl drum set they were joined by equally dysfunctional horns: a thrift store tuba (Tubano), knock off Indian valve trombone (Tom Bone) and street find trumpet (Roly). Together they make (mostly) wordless sound eruptions that have only best been described as if Danny Elfman and Eliot Smith had a baby and if fell down a spiral staircase in New Orleans Come try and describe the ear twisting music yourself! See ya on the asphalt!

big_desc:
Lecture 6 | Dale Chihuly

How Tacoma s own Chihuly brought Studio Glass into the global imagination, inspiring countless artists and redefining glass as large-scale public art.

In celebration of America s 250th anniversary in 2026, and in partnership with America 250, Forged in Fire at Museum of Glass will combine illustrated lectures, live glassblowing demonstrations, and multimedia content to trace the evolution of American glassmaking, from colonial Jamestown to the contemporary works of Dale Chihuly. Each event illuminates the artistry, design, and cultural significance of glass as both a decorative and functional medium. Forged in Fire will reach diverse audiences throughout the Puget Sound region and beyond via in-person events and live streams, and build community pride in the region s unique role in the American Studio Glass Movement — a movement co-founded by Tacoma-native Dale Chihuly. By combining history, artistry, and live craft, this program exemplifies how decorative arts can spark curiosity, fuel discovery, and create shared cultural experiences.

Lectures and Demonstrations

Museum of Glass will host six unique public sessions pairing glass history talks by renowned glass artist and historian Walter Lieberman with live demonstrations by the Museum s internationally acclaimed Hot Shop Team. Each lecture focuses on a specific period of time in glassmaking history and is accompanied by a demonstration that recreates period-specific objects and techniques, giving audiences tangible insight into the evolution of glass as a decorative art form. All lectures will take place on select Saturdays 1pm in the Museum of Glass Hot Shop. The glassmaking demonstrations will follow at 2pm.

description: Heritage Skills Workshops preserve traditional skills through instruction, demonstration, and hands-on learning. Join us as we go through traditional methods of extracting a Puget Sound delicacy. Shucking is a culinary term used to describe the removal of the outer shell or shucks from either corn or oysters. Interestingly, the term is not used in relation to any other food items, and corn and oysters have very little else in common. big_desc: Tacoma City Theaters Presents Hyprov: Under Hypnosis RESERVE SEATS Date Feb 11 , 2027 Event Starts 7:30 PM Doors Open 6:30 PM Venue Pantages Theater On Sale On Sale Now Thursday, February 11 7:30 PM RESERVE SEATS Event Details Stunning audiences throughout North America and Europe and making them ask, Is this real? , the duo is set to prove it with their latest tour. The live show, which has been called hilarious and fascinating by Time Out New York, combines hypnosis and improv for a one-of-a-kind comedy experience. We are so excited to launch this new tour and return to some of our favorite cities and visit some new ones, said Asad Mecci. It s been an incredible journey. And we just want to remind everyone, YES! It s real, exclaims Colin Mochrie. HYPROV has been acclaimed by prestigious publications, with The New York Times declaring, The audience erupted in laughter. It killed. The Wall Street Journal praised it as catnip for those who relish spontaneity and informality, and The New Yorker advised, Say yes to HYPROV. The 90-minute show combines hypnosis and improv—two art forms that have mystified and entertained fans, skeptics, and everyone in between. The evening begins with Mecci welcoming 20 volunteers on stage to be hypnotized. The most receptive to hypnosis then join Mochrie to improvise the rest of the show while hypnotized. In the hands of two experts and solely crafted from the volunteers and audiences uninhibited, unconscious minds, each show is an entirely original and completely unforgettable theatrical experience. HYPROV was created in 2016 at Toronto s Second City. After working it out on stage, they took the show on the road to Just for Laughs London, Just for Laughs Montreal, and the Edinburgh Fringe, where it was received with rave reviews in 2016 and 2017. The duo set out on a 100-city tour from 2019 to 2023, performed 12 weeks off-Broadway in NYC, six months at Harrah s Las Vegas, and a 16-show residency at the CAA Theatre in Toronto. The Kareem Kandi World Orchestra is a dynamic and innovative ensemble committed to providing high-quality performances and music education to communities worldwide. Through a blend of concerts, workshops, compositions, recordings, and cultural exchanges, the orchestra brings people together through the universal language of music, with a special emphasis on the rich traditions of jazz.

Led by saxophonist, composer, and educator Kareem Kandi, the orchestra draws on his vast experience as a performer who has earned acclaim for his work in jazz, blues, classical, and funk. A native of the Pacific Northwest, Kareems versatility as a saxophonist and composer has taken him across the U.S. and around the globe, captivating audiences and critics alike. Known for his ability to honor the traditions of the past while forging new creative pathways, Kareems compositions and unique arrangements of timeless American standards continue to push musical boundaries.

Since 1996, Kareem has performed as both a bandleader and sideman, sharing the stage with luminaries such as Patti Labelle, Ali Jackson, George Colligan, Pete Christlieb, Bill Watrous, The Seattle Symphony, The Paperboys, The Temptations, The Four Tops, and many more. His work with The Kareem Kandi World Orchestra featuring embodies a sound that is fresh, innovative, and appeals to a diverse range of audiences. Each member brings decades of experience and mastery of their instruments, contributing to a performance that transcends genres and connects with listeners on many levels.

About Ali Jackson:

Ali Jackson has performed and recorded with a multitude of artists including Wynton Marsalis, Jon Batiste, Willie Nelson, Tony Bennett, Faith Hill, Karriem Riggins, Bobby McFerrin, Buster Williams, Norah Jones, Eric Clapton, Dee Dee Bridgewater, Aretha Franklin, George Benson, Harry Connick, Jr., KRS-1, Marcus Roberts, Joshua Redman, Vinx, Seito Kinen, Seiji Ozawa, Diana Krall, Gerald Albright, Michael Heise, Russell Gunn, James Morrison, Craig Handy, Jacky Terrasson, Kurt Rosenwinkel, and the New York City Ballet.

As a bandleader, Ali has recorded five albums, including Amalgamations, Wheelz Keep Rollin , Big Brown Getdown and the Yes! Trio album. Ali s playing is featured on more than 40 other albums, including Congo Square, Touchdown, Gunn Fu, Young Gunn Plus, European Sessions, Live at Yoshi s, Reflections in Change, Back East, Two Men With The Blues, Three-Five, Here We Go Again: Celebrating the Genius of Ray Charles, He and She, The Magic Hour and From the Plantation to the Penitentiary. Jackson also collaborated with jazz greats Cyrus Chestnut, Reginald Veal, and James

Carter on Gold Sounds, an innovative album that sought to transform songs by indie alternative rock band Pavement into unique virtuosic interpretations with the spirit of the church and the attitude of the juke joint. His production skills can be heard on George Benson s album Irreplaceable. He is also the voice of Duck Ellington, a character in the Penguin book series Baby Loves Jazz.

Ali is also an acclaimed composer whose voice is unique in its command of the universal language of the groove and the power of thoughtful use of space — both rhythmically and harmonically. His most recent masterworks include the Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra-commissioned Living Grooves: A World in Jazz Rhythm and a ballet composed for the Alvin Ailey Dance Company titled r-Evolution, Dream.

Ali s collaborations with other artists continue to push the envelope of jazz music and its connection to the human spirit. In 2010, Ali executive produced an original work called Beats of NYC, a project blending the musical idioms of Congolese, Senegalese, Tap, and modern dances juxtaposed with various styles of spoken word and the history of the blues. He also composed a ballet with long-time collaborator Hope Boykin titled Ballet: Watching go by the Day.

big_desc:
Junior Community Scientists

Ever wondered what it s like to participate in community science projects? Join Communities for a Healthy Bay for a hands-on half-day adventure exploring Commencement Bay from the water and the shore!

Youth will depart from the CHB office aboard our boat for a bay patrol, stopping along the way to conduct real water quality testing and help record water color data for ongoing monitoring efforts. Next, they ll get up close with the bay s smallest residents during a plankton sampling session, using nets and microscopes to see what s living beneath the surface.
The adventure continues at Owen Beach, where kids will join in a Green Crab Molt Search — helping track this invasive species by combing the shoreline for shed crab shells — before refueling with a provided lunch by the water. Then it s back aboard for the cruise home to the CHB office.

Kids will leave with real hands-on science experience, a better understanding of the bay they call home, and a taste of what it means to protect it.

This program is FREE! Lunch is provided.

Ages 10–16
Friday, October 23 | 12:30 PM – 4:30 PM
Departs and returns from the CHB office
⚓ Spots are very limited due to boat capacity — sign up today!

title: Live at the Eleanor with Jazz Therapy
description: Jazz Therapy : This Christmas A Soulful Jazz Celebration – Featuring the music of This Christmas, plus soulful songs and gospel selections — Donny Hathaway, Stevie Wonder, The Carpenters, and The Preacher s Wife. THE BAND Teal Warren – Bass Pete Yankeh – Drums Henry Nielsen – Piano Bill Throssell – Trumpet & Flugel Horn Jon Fotheringill – Alto & Tenor Saxophone SPECIAL GUEST VOCALISTS Alma Villegas Cathy Satava In the vibrant tapestry of sound, where rhythm meets soul, Jazz Therapy emerges as a powerful force of musical healing. Born from the depths of rich jazz tradition and a passion for emotional expression, this dynamic ensemble brings an unparalleled fusion of soulful melodies, intricate rhythms, and exuberant improvisation that captivate audiences of all ages. Leader and visionary Teal Warren, renowned for his mastery of the bass and a deep-rooted passion for jazz as both a musician and army veteran, guides Jazz Therapy with an intuitive sense of harmony and collaboration. Drawing inspiration from many jazz legends, the ensemble creates a sonic universe where each note resonates with vibrant energy, inviting listeners to not only hear but to feel the music s transformative power. Collaborating with a talented lineup of seasoned musicians, Jazz Therapy is about more than just music—it s an experience. From the pulsing beats of slap bass to the gentle caress of a saxophone solo, every performance is a journey that fosters connection, reflection, and empowerment. This sense of unity is the bedrock of the band s philosophy, which centers on music as an innovative therapy — a sanctuary where individuals can come together, heal, and grow. With accolades that span esteemed jazz festivals and high-profile events, Jazz Therapy s eclectic repertoire seamlessly weaves in influences from modern jazz, blues, and world music, crafting a sound that s both a nod to the classics and a fresh auditory exploration. Each performance is an opportunity to not only entertain but to touch hearts and ignite spirits with the transformative magic of jazz. Jazz Therapy invites you to dive into their world, where music is the remedy and every performance is a soulful recollection of the universal language that binds us all. Whether you are a jazz connoisseur or a curious soul seeking refuge through sound, Jazz Therapy is exceptional, unforgettable, and ready to heal. Live at The Eleanor offers a cozy candlelit lounge experience where each performance unfolds like a conversation between artist and audience. Full bar and concessions are available; all ages are welcome.

Whether you re new to Pilates or looking to refresh your routine, PAEClates offers a supportive and energizing way to kick off your week.

title: Polyrhythmics
description: Funk-soul-R&B-jazz-Afrobeat Polyrhythmics For those whove ever wondered what Massive Attack would sound like doing bong hits with Miles Davis - The Georgia Straight Seattle-based Polyrhythmics are celebrating 16 years of sonic exploration following the release of their latest album, Life from Below (2025). Since forming in 2010, this six piece powerhouse has redefined instrumental music with a sound that blends funk, soul, psychedelic rock, R&B, and Afrobeat into a kaleidoscope of rhythm and groove. Known for their dynamic live performances and innovative compositions, the band has earned a reputation as one of the most captivating acts on the contemporary music scene. Polyrhythmics emerged from the rich creative soil of Seattles eclectic music community, releasing their self-titled debut album in 2011. Since then, their discography has grown to include fan-favorite albums such as Octagon (2015), Caldera (2017), Man from the Future (2020), and Life From Below (2025). Each release showcases their fearless exploration of genre boundaries and their commitment to crafting vibrant, deeply textured soundscapes. Last years Life From Below marked an exciting chapter for Polyrhythmics, delivering a fresh collection of grooves infused with the bold creativity and signature tight-knit musicianship that fans have come to expect. The band reflects on over a decade and a half of musical evolution, countless miles on the road, and a loyal community of listeners that continues to grow. Over the years, Polyrhythmics have graced stages at major festivals and renowned venues across the United States and internationally, sharing bills with legendary artists while carving out a distinct space in the global funk and soul scene. Their music - equal parts danceable, thoughtful, and immersive - offers a rich listening experience that draws from the roots of American funk and soul while incorporating global influences. As Polyrhythmics continue their journey, they remain committed to pushing boundaries, creating new grooves, and bringing their celebrated live energy to audiences around the world. title: Sam Millers Hangover Extravaganza
description: Sam Miller is a nationally touring comedian from Olympia, Washington. He is 6 foot 6, 360 pounds, has two kids, (one of them is on purpose) hes been married for 15 years, and has been clean and sober for 17 years. Sam likes to make jokes about what its like to be a sober parent. He also likes to make jokes about what jails like in Yakima. His first album and special, Round Trip, was recorded and filmed under the tutelage of Grammy-winning producer Dan Schlissel, whose indie label, Stand Up! Records, Sam had recently signed a three-album deal with. Round Trip was released October 27th 2023 and immediately went to number one on the iTunes Comedy Charts. It even broke into the top 200 overall charts. Sam is a recurring guest and has been heard by an estimated 2.5 million listeners on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Radio Show. He has written for Newsweek. He was the runner-up in the 2021 Seattle International Comedy Competition and won the Comedy on Trial Competition in 2017. He has headlined multiple major comedy clubs including Sidesplitters in Tampa, Helium in Portland, and The Laugh Factory and Zanies in Chicago. Hes also performed with the Addicts Comedy Tour and at NA and AA conventions all over the country. For three consecutive years, he won awards in The Best of Olympia issue of the Weekly Volcano. 2016 Best Local Hero 2017 Best Local Celebrity 2018 Best Comic Relief

address: TACOMA WA 98415, PO Box 5764, TACOMA, WA 98415
description: Steve and Kristi Nebel (pron. knee bull) will be in concert with the duo, Blue Ribbon Tea Company on Friday, November 20th and Saturday November 21st at 7 pm at the Dukesbay Theater, located in The Merlino Art Center, 508 S. Sixth Ave #10, Tacoma, WA 98402. This will be an opportunity for an intimate, interactive experience in a venue with limited seating. The cover charge is $25 in advance and $30 at the door. The two days will be distinctly different concerts and tickets for combined dates are $50 each. Advance tickets are available at https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/V9JYSN5G896MY Steve & Kristi Nebel . . . gave us a marvelous night of song to conclude their UK tour. Now rousing, now lyrical, now witty, now heart-felt. Great stuff. Peter Armstrong, Organizer, Bridge Folk Club, Newcastle, UK 9/2026 Steve and Kristi Nebel bring passion, finesse, and raw beauty to the stage with their trademark blend of Americana and contemporary folk. Based out of Tacoma, Washington, this powerhouse duo has spent decades crafting songs that deliver knife-edge observations, stories gathered from their extensive travels, and poignant reflections on social justice. Backed by Steve s thoughtful, melodic guitar and Kristi s driving electric bass, their voices lock into a flawless harmony that critics note exceeds the sum of its parts. With an expansive discography—including their chart-topping album Vignettes—the Nebels have shared their working-class chronicles everywhere from Northwest mainstays to extensive tours across UK folk clubs and festivals. A performance by the Nebels is an intimate journey through heart, history, and the human spirit. Learn more about the Nebels at sknebel.com The Blue Ribbon Tea Company: Y all were perfect! Great night, great crowd, great music. I couldn t have asked for better truthfully, I don t think we got a better response from a first time artist on the patio. Isamu Som Jordan, Entertainment writer and Booking agent. Bill and Kathy Kostelec are long-time respected Spokane folk musicians known for compelling songwriting and distinctive vocals (accompanied by guitar, mandolin, and fiddle). They also enjoy playing old blues, country, and folk tunes and have performed at multiple Woody Guthrie tribute shows. Their authentic and earthy feel is more like gritty work boots and garden shoes than spit shined dress shoes, but they are the real deal and a gold standard (press). Numerous Kostelec songs have aired on public and community radio. They ve released six albums with the seventh in the works. They will be joined on bass by longtime friend Kevin Hiller. From Spokane, to Chicago, to Seattle, Kevin has performed with various bands for decades and is highly skilled in roots, rock, gospel, and heavy metal music. A lifelong church vocalist, Natasha Pauw will join them as well singing harmony. Learn more about Bill and Kathy at TheBlueRibbonTeaCompany.com For information call Kristi Nebel at (253)439-7985 Email: kristi.steve.nebel@gmail.com

title: Tacoma s Chinese Expulsion of 1885
description: On November 3, 1885, five hundred white Tacomans rounded up hundreds of the citys remaining Chinese residents and forcibly marched them through the pouring rain to a railroad station and crammed them into boxcars bound for Portland. After terrorizing local businessmen known to be supporters of the Chinese, this mob burned Tacomas Chinatown to the ground. The mob was so methodical in its expulsion of Chinese residents, local newspapers reported, that its approach was hailed as the Tacoma Method. Tacomas Chinese Expulsion was the dark culmination of national and local anti-Chinese sentiment, numerous outbursts of violence in the Puget Sound region, and a culture within the city of Tacoma that reinforced xenophobia and an enduring nativism. The terrorism in Tacoma dehumanized an immigrant population and stimulated expulsions of Chinese communities in over two hundred West Coast and Northwest towns and cities between 1885 and 1887.

title: Tanael Joachim
description: Fresh off a TV pilot filmed for FX, TJ is back on the road with new jokes about love, death, grief, and immigration. Come for the same fresh, incisive, and caustic wit, stay for the poetry of laughter to be found within the darkest of subjects. The Alien Everywhere is TJs third standup tour. Following successful stints in North America and Europe, hes ready hit the road again and bring jokes from the singular Haitian perspective to the rest of the English speaking world. Hes also planning to add a few more countries, and even continents to this one. He hopes to see you in a room, wherever in the world you live, laughing together at the human condition. About TJ (Tanael Joachim) TJ (Tanael Joachim) is a Haitian born stand-up comedian who is currently based in New York City. TJ has a very laid back, smooth, and conversational style. He jokes about race, societys idiosyncrasies, and the inherent contrast between life in Haiti and America. He has made appearances on Gotham Comedy Live (AXS TV) and Good Day New York (FOX). TJ is a paid regular at the Comedy Cellar and Gotham Comedy Club in NYC. He has performed all over the world. He recently returned from a small European tour where he performed in English and French. He has opened for Colin Quinn, Janelle James, Maria Bamford and Sean Patton. He has also been a featured performer at numerous festivals like Netflix Is A Joke Festival, SF Sketchfest and the Eugene Mirman Comedy Festival. TJ is also an Op-Ed contributor for The New York Times. You can watch his special, JANUARY 3RD, on Amazon and listen to his album, SON OF HAITI, on all audio platforms. Check out his Dont Tell Comedy set on YouTube. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/tjstandup/

Armed with musicianship and passion, this three-piece band leaves it all on the stage every time the amps get warm. Their performances are unpretentious, witty, and guaranteed to make a crowd move. The bands unique set of influences brings out songs that have a sensibility that spans decades. Slices of 80s punk topped with sprinkles of 90s rock and spatters of country make up a big steaming batch of awesome. They feature a veteran line-up of Seattle musicians including: Eric Chapman (Big Splash Champion, Kingpin Hayes) on drums, Kyle Curnutt (We Are Not Mel Torme, Radio Telescope) on bass, and Steve Bergstrom (Dapper Jones) on vocals and guitar. The Finger Guns have released five albums to date: A Double EP , The Bigfoot EP , Yeti , their vinyl debut Sasquatch , Blowsy , and their sixth release, Finch . The band has supported these releases with shows all over the PNW and West Coast. Lets rock this together. end Act 2 Act 2 About Filthy Traitors Filthy Traitors is a Seattle-based garage punk band that began as an idea in late 2016. Female-fronted, the band mixes old school punk rock with a heavy, sometimes sludgy vibe and the constant thread of soaring melody. Known for their high energy live shows and songs about murder mysteries and serial killers, theyve become a northwest staple, regularly touring throughout the west coast while steadily building a loyal local following. end Act 2 Act 2 About bend. bend. invites you to experience the tasty treat that is their sound! A musical charcuterie board filled with artful styles full of both color and sound for a one-of-a-kind, flavorful experience. Founding members Dan Roth (drums) & Nance Veltkamp (vocals, tambourine) recently welcomed accomplished musician, poet, writer and artist Sasha Victor on trombone to create brass-infused alt rock with blues-punk roots. Joining bend. for showsis the incredibly talented producer/guitarist/bassist Victor Payne. Longtime friend Cody Sanders is bend.s most recent addition, an epic talent on both guitar and bass. This emerging PAC NW band is reimagining originals and mash-ups of songs you never knew you needed! bend.s single, Dandelion, has been played nationwide on WildDogsRadio (IN), KISW 99.9 FM (Seattle), Local Roots Music NW on 99.1 FM (Portland), Radio Tacoma 101.9 FM & the Paradise Valley Radio Hour on Vashon Island. Bend. - More than just a band, its a vibe. end Act 2 Act 2 About Samcori Fans say Samcoris evocative, often hilarious songs are unforgettable, earning her a loyal following in the northwest and beyond, opening for legendary acts such as Crash Test Dummies at The Lincoln Theater in Mount Vernon and for TI at Nate Jacksons Super Funny Comedy Club in Tacoma. She recently won Up and Coming Artist and Best Hip Hop Artist in the Washington State Independent Music Awards. Her original song Titanic Down was chosen as a finalist in the annual Local Roots NW song competition. end Act 2

title: Walk for Reconciliation Against Racism 2026
description: The Chinese Reconciliation Project Foundation invites the public to join them and the Washington State Historical Museum at the 2026 Walk for Reconciliation Against Racism. This annual demonstration r…
big_desc:
The Chinese Reconciliation Project Foundation invites the public to join them and the Washington State Historical Museum at the 2026 Walk for Reconciliation Against Racism. This annual demonstration retraces and reverses the walking path of expulsion forced on Tacomas Chinese American population in 1885, reclaiming the City for all peoples and cultures.

The walk, led by civic, educational, business and faith leaders, will begin near Union Station, where the Chinese pioneers in 1885 were marched at gunpoint out of town. Walkers will proceed north, led by Chinese Lion Dancers, through downtown Tacoma where many Chinese, and later Japanese businesses and houses once stood, along Schuster Parkway and the railroad- largely built by Chinese labor, and finally arrive at the Chinese Reconciliation Park. Throughout the walk, attendees will be within a half mile of the Northwest ICE Processing Center (NWIPC) where a similar white nationalist agenda continues to be orchestrated.

This year, the Opening Ceremony will take place inside the Washington State History Museums Mt. Tahoma Auditorium at 10 AM. After brief remarks from our Emcee and guest speaker, the Walk will begin from outside the Union Station around 10:45 AM. Walkers will arrive at the Chinese Reconciliation Park by 12 PM, and the event will conclude with final remarks, performances, and refreshments. To learn more about our guest speakers and our events timing, please visit our website.

Event Timing

  • Welcome Speeches begin at 10 AM, in the Washington State History Museum s Mt. Tahoma Auditorium.
  • The walk begins at 11 AM, from the History Museum s auditorium to the Tacoma Chinese Reconciliation Park.
  • The Conclusion Ceremony begins at 12:30 PM, at the Tacoma Chinese Reconciliation Park, featuring remarks from local dignitaries, a performance, and refreshments.

This event is free, open to all and families and children are most welcome. Join us in solidarity on Saturday, October 24th as we commit ourselves to anti-racism in the City of Destiny

Bus Schedule

To ensure our Walk for Reconciliation Against Racism is inclusive and accessible to all, we have organized a bus to transport participants who are unable to walk the three mile distance from the Union Station to the Tacoma Chinese Reconciliation Park.

  • The bus leaves the Union Station area at 10:45 AM, to transport attendees to the Chinese Reconciliation Park
  • The bus back leaves the Chinese Reconciliation Park at 1:15 PM, bringing attendees back to the Union Station.

History of The Tacoma Method

November 3, 2026, is the 141st anniversary of the 1885 expulsion of all remaining Chinese residents of Tacoma (possibly as many as 200 people). Many Chinese had left earlier that fall because of the hostile atmosphere here in Tacoma. The Chinese Must Go campaign was not an official act of the City government, but it was openly instigated and organized by elected officials (including the mayor and members of the City Council) and other leading citizens of civic influence. Soon after the event, the expulsion became known as the Tacoma Method in a rising tide of anti-Chinese sentiment and acts of violence in the western United States.

Join us in solidarity on Saturday, October 24th as we commit ourselves to anti-racism in the City of Destiny.

For more information, visit crpftacoma.org or contact Ben Everett at info@crpftacoma.org.

description: WHERE BLOOMING FLOWERS MEET THE SKY Show the world your art. Show your brother the world. You are fierce Zhuli. But you re also kind. Where Blooming Flowers Meet The Sky follows Zhuli, a young artist searching for her place in the world as she writes a new book of poetry. Join Communities for a Healthy Bay (CHB) for a fun and immersive day of outdoor learning in Point Defiance Park! On October 24th from 10am–2pm, youth ages 10–16 are invited to take part in a free environmental education program in collaboration with local expert naturalist Junie B. Fungal.

Participants will enjoy a guided walk through the park s forested trails, discovering the incredible diversity of wild mushrooms and native plants that thrive in the Pacific Northwest. Along the way, we ll pause to observe, ask questions, and learn how these organisms play a vital role in our local ecosystems. The program will also include a provided lunch break and an engaging, interactive presentation from Junie B. Fungal, who will share insights into the fascinating and often surprising world of fungi.

Whether you re curious about nature, love being outside, or just want to try something new, this is a unique opportunity to connect with the natural world and learn from an expert in a beautiful setting. Space is limited—don t miss out on this exciting day of exploration!
